name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

accessibility.description: Skyrim Access adds speech, navigation assistance and audio cues to the Windows Special and Anniversary editions. Installation requires SKSE, the matching Address Library and SkyUI; use the current guide for the exact Steam or GOG runtime and dependencies. Accessibility is a work in progress, and browsing or installing Creations still needs sighted assistance. Console editions and the standalone Anniversary Upgrade DLC are not replacements for the required PC base game.
